# Tissue biopsy

The patient-level outcome is the number of unique calendar days on which a
biopsy was performed.  Multiple biopsy records on the same date count once.
The adjusted Bayesian negative-binomial model includes randomized treatment,
linear age, ECOG collapsed to 0/1/2/3+, and the offset
`log(observed_survival_days)`.

Observed survival days are derived from the fixed data lock and death or
administrative follow-up dates.  Missing dates and missing counts remain
missing and are not substituted with zero; positive exposure is required by
the count-model contract.

```{r}
#| eval: false

source(here::here("analysis", "05-secondary", "secondary-helpers.R"))
source(here::here("R", "count-helpers.R"))
source(here::here("R", "paths-artifacts.R"))
source(here::here("R", "data-validation.R"))

cohort <- read_pseudonymized_parquet(
  here::here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet"),
  schema = here::here("data", "schema", "cohort_follow_up.yml")
)
biopsy_path <- here::here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-biopsy.parquet")
if (!file.exists(biopsy_path)) {
  stop(
    "Tissue-biopsy analysis is pending: no approved event-level biopsy table " ,
    "is available; the participant aggregate is not substituted for biopsy events."
  )
}
biopsy <- read_pseudonymized_parquet(
  biopsy_path,
  schema = here::here("data", "schema", "biopsy.yml")
)

biopsy$sample_date <- secondary_parse_date(
  biopsy$sample_date, "sample_date", allow_missing = FALSE
)
# Count only biopsy events observed between randomization and each participant's
# fixed-lock/182-day observed end.  Multiple records on one date count once.
biopsy_data <- secondary_observed_follow_up(
  cohort, origin_col = "randomization_date", horizon_days = 182L,
  output_col = "observed_survival_days"
)
biopsy_lookup <- biopsy_data[, c("id", "randomization_date", "observed_end_date"),
                             drop = FALSE]
biopsy <- merge(biopsy, biopsy_lookup, by = "id", all = FALSE)
biopsy <- biopsy[biopsy$sample_date >= biopsy$randomization_date &
                   biopsy$sample_date <= biopsy$observed_end_date, , drop = FALSE]
unique_day <- !duplicated(paste(as.character(biopsy$id), biopsy$sample_date, sep = "\r"))
biopsy_counts <- as.data.frame(table(as.character(biopsy$id[unique_day])),
                               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
names(biopsy_counts) <- c("id", "unique_biopsy_days")
biopsy_counts$unique_biopsy_days <- as.integer(biopsy_counts$unique_biopsy_days)
biopsy_data <- secondary_join_count(biopsy_data, biopsy_counts, "unique_biopsy_days")
biopsy_data$ecog_3_plus <- secondary_collapse_ecog(biopsy_data$ecog_fstcnt)
secondary_count_ready(biopsy_data, "unique_biopsy_days", "observed_survival_days")

biopsy_formula <- unique_biopsy_days ~ tx + age + ecog_3_plus +
  offset(log(observed_survival_days))
biopsy_fit <- rstanarm::stan_glm(
  formula = biopsy_formula,
  data = biopsy_data,
  family = rstanarm::neg_binomial_2(),
  chains = 4,
  iter = 1000,
  warmup = 500,
  seed = 17006
)
write_atomic_parquet(
  biopsy_data[, c("id", "tx", "unique_biopsy_days", "observed_survival_days")],
  project_path("results", "secondary", "tissue-biopsy", "endpoint.parquet")
)
```
